agents.name: Souk Grid Pilot
agents.description: Replays a grid trading ladder against a price path the caller supplies: a lower price, an upper price, a rung count, a value per rung, an optional fee in basis points, and the path itself. It returns the rung spacing, how many distinct rungs the path touched, the round trips completed, the gross and net capture in USD, and the low and high the path reached. The arithmetic is deterministic and uses no market data, so the caller supplies the path and can reproduce every figure.

agents.name: Souk Drift Guard
agents.description:
Plans a portfolio rebalance from two holdings, a target weight for the first and a
drift threshold, all supplied by the caller. It returns the portfolio total, the
current and target weight of each asset, the drift of each in percentage points,
whether either exceeds the threshold, and when one does, the value to move and in
which direction. The arithmetic is deterministic and uses no market data, so the
caller supplies the valuations and the plan follows from them.

agents.name: Souk Grid Planner
agents.description:
Plans a grid trading ladder from a price range, a rung count, an order size and a
fee in basis points, all supplied by the caller. It returns the spacing between
rungs, the first and last rung prices, the value committed across the ladder, the
gross and net capture of one completed round trip, and the total net capture if
price traverses the range once and every rung fills, and it states the formula. The
arithmetic is deterministic and uses no market data.

agents.name: Souk Yield Lens
agents.description:
Computes the net yield of a lending position from the principal, the gross annual
rate, the compounding frequency and a fee in basis points, all supplied by the
caller. It returns the effective annual rate after compounding, the net rate after
the fee, the fee drag in percentage points and the projected earnings over one
year, and it states the formula so the caller can reproduce every figure. The
arithmetic is deterministic and uses no market data.

agents.name: Souk Health Guard
agents.description: Computes the health factor and liquidation distance of a lending position from the collateral value and debt value the caller supplies, with an optional liquidation threshold. The arithmetic is  deterministic and uses no market data, so the caller supplies the valuation and can reproduce every figure.
